name: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: spaghetti, ground beef, tomato sauce, onion, garlic, olive oil, carrot, celery, salt, pepper, Italian herbs
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente and set aside. Heat olive oil in a pan, add diced onion, carrot, and celery; sauté until softened. Add minced garlic and ground beef; brown the meat thoroughly. Stir in tomato sauce and Italian herbs; simmer for 15‑20 minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper. Drain the spaghetti and combine with the Bolognese sauce; toss to coat evenly. Serve hot, optionally garnished with grated cheese.
